text: 对“黄”的态度能大概率反应一个人的“精神”阶级属性
en: One's attitude towards "pornography" can, in all likelihood, reflect a person's "spiritual" class attribute.

text: 顶端天龙人性资源异常丰富 根本无所谓
en: The top-tier celestial dragons have an abnormally abundant supply of sexual resources, so they couldn't care less.

text: 甚至少部分人会对正常的X生活腻歪 口味不断加重
en: Even a small minority grow tired of a normal sex life, and their tastes keep escalating.

text: 进而导致异常猎奇 刺激变态现象的发生
en: Which in turn leads to the occurrence of abnormal curiosity-seeking and stimulating, perverted phenomena.

text: 底端人口应该拥护国家目前的涉黄政策
en: The bottom-tier population should support the state's current pornography-related policies.

text: 因为从事该行业的妇女 绝大多说也都是底端
en: Because the vast majority of women engaged in this industry also come from the bottom tier.

text: 换言之 不是你的老婆就是你未来的女儿
en: In other words, they are either your wife or your future daughter.

text: 即使政策放开 他们也成为不了“李师师”
en: Even if the policy were relaxed, they could never become a "Shishi Li".

text: 高级社交媛 是落魄贵族的最后一张饭票 轮不上底端人口 她们没资格去舔
en: High-society socialites are the last meal ticket for fallen aristocrats; the bottom tier never gets a turn, and they are in no position to suck up to them.

text: 目前咱们国家 “失足妇女”低龄化 未成年化倾向很明显
en: At present, in our country, the tendency towards younger and even underage "fallen women" is very pronounced.

text: 这还是在“严打”的情况下
en: And this is still under the conditions of the "strike-hard" campaign.

text: 一旦放开。
en: Once it is relaxed.

en: The ones who most support relaxation are the middle class.

text: 他们很艳羡天龙人但自己性资源不多
en: They envy the celestial dragons greatly but have few sexual resources of their own.

text: 但鱼肉一下底端 还是绰绰有余
en: But to exploit the bottom tier a bit is still more than enough for them.

en: After relaxation, once the price market drops, it shows them all the more the benefit of "value for money".

text: 黄赌毒不分家 一旦做大 必然产生黑恶势力
en: Porn, gambling and drugs are inseparable; once they grow large, they inevitably give rise to organised criminal forces.

text: 中产甚至有可能掺和一下 做大自己 改变自己的阶层
en: The middle class may even get involved, growing themselves and changing their own class.

text: 所以人得知道自己的屁股坐哪儿 为谁说话。

text: 《姐姐妹妹站起来》
en: Sisters Stand Up

text: 里面演老鸨的那个演员就是电影女主角的原型，为了演好这部电影她克服着内心最痛苦的回忆。
en: The actress who played the brothel madam in it was the real-life model for the film's female lead; to perform well in this film, she overcame her most painful inner memories.

text: 不要拿什么谁合法谁不合法来举例子，也没有人告诉你那些卖淫合法的国家里妓女就过得很好，就像你可能都不知道巴勒斯坦人挨了以色列人七十年炸。
en: Don't use examples of who is legal and who isn't, and no one told you that prostitutes live well in those countries where prostitution is legal — just as you probably don't even know that Palestinians have been bombed by Israelis for seventy years.

text: 如果有一天，你欠了钱，你的债主拉着你妻女画个押，然后让她们去卖淫，你这会告官，官说卖淫是合法的，她俩这算是工作还清债务，你那会求谁去呢？
en: If one day you owe money, and your creditor drags your wife and daughter to put their marks, then sends them to prostitute themselves — you go to the authorities, and the authorities say prostitution is legal, so the two of them are considered to be working off the debt; whom would you plead to then?

text: 别长一张嘴，走路嫌车多，开车嫌人多，这个社会的秩序不是围绕你一个人转的，你要觉得别人合法是先进，那有的国家还合法飞叶子呢？
en: Don't just open your mouth and, when walking, complain there are too many cars, and when driving, complain there are too many people. The order of this society does not revolve around you alone. If you think others being legal is progressive, well, some countries have legalised smoking weed too?

text: 你去不是完事了。
en: You go and that settles it.

text: 像是看到那种顾左右言他，拿包养情妇说事的，你就建议他：
en: When you see that kind of person who dodges the question and brings up keeping a mistress, you should advise them:

text: 如果你发现公务人员包养情妇或嫖娼可以举报，情节属实将以《行政机关公务员处分条例》和《中国共产党纪律处分条例》处罚，普通公务员通常是撤职或开除，领导双开——“包养情妇”属于严重违纪，在近几年落马的官员中，因为情妇的占相当一部分，画面大家也是喜闻乐见了。
en: If you discover that a public servant keeps a mistress or visits prostitutes, you can report it; if the circumstances are confirmed, they will be punished under the Regulations on the Punishment of Civil Servants in Administrative Organs and the Regulations on Disciplinary Punishments of the Communist Party of China. Ordinary civil servants are usually removed from their posts or dismissed; leading cadres are "double-discharged" — keeping a mistress constitutes a serious disciplinary violation, and among officials brought down in recent years, a considerable portion fell because of mistresses, a scene the public is all too familiar with.

text: 相比之下，这方面欧美国家“似乎”还要更开放“一些”。
en: By comparison, in this regard European and American countries seem even more open.

text: 如果真是要和你聊卖淫合法性的，你就让他先举例——哪些地方卖淫是合法的？
en: If they really want to discuss the legality of prostitution with you, tell them to give examples first — where exactly is prostitution legal?

text: 因为和许多人想象中不一样的是——其实大部分发达国家和地区是禁娼的，有些地区甚至还有搞笑的“罚嫖不罚娼”，即嫖客可以罚款、妓女只需要口头教育，比如法国（为此还吸引了一些国内女孩过去）。
en: Because, contrary to what many imagine — in fact most developed countries and regions ban prostitution, and some regions even have the absurd "fine the client, not the prostitute" rule, where the client can be fined while the prostitute only needs a verbal warning, such as France (which has thereby attracted some of our domestic girls over).

text: 这种事情在你眼中是你花了几百块钱和一个女子“共度良宵”，所谓“你情我愿”的事情——你确实是“情”的，但问题是你怎么确定对方是“愿”呢？
en: In your eyes, this matter is you spending a few hundred yuan to "spend a good night" with a woman, a so-called "mutual consent" affair — you are indeed "willing", but the question is how do you determine the other party is "consenting"?

text: 事实上，性交易除了伴随有“强迫”外，还和许多恶性犯罪具有强烈相关性，其中我认为最恶劣的当属「人口贩卖」。
en: In fact, apart from being accompanied by "coercion", sex trading is also strongly correlated with many heinous crimes, among which I consider human trafficking the very worst.

text: 最典型的例子就是在东欧剧变后，经济崩溃、失业率大幅上升的后果是有相当多的东欧少女被贩卖到西欧和北美从事色情行业，比如卖淫、拍色情片、做性奴以及代孕等，甚至还会拍摄虐杀视频以供取乐。
en: The most typical example is that after the upheaval in Eastern Europe, with economic collapse and a sharp rise in unemployment, a considerable number of Eastern European girls were trafficked to Western Europe and North America to engage in the sex industry — such as prostitution, porn film shooting, sex slavery and surrogacy — and some were even filmed in torture-killing videos for others' amusement.

text: 人贩子往往以“打工”或“恋爱”等为名把少女骗过去出卖，之后大都就是困在一个小房间里失去人身自由，在频繁地接客后，最终在毒品、虐待、疾病、精神崩溃等折磨中痛苦地死去——在西方许多电影中都有体现类似的情节。
en: Human traffickers often lure girls away under the guise of "work" or "romance" and sell them; afterwards most are confined in a small room, losing their personal freedom, and after frequently receiving clients, they finally die in agony under the torment of drugs, abuse, disease, mental breakdown and the like — similar plots are depicted in many Western films.

text: 而这条黑色的产业链直到今天都没有断绝......犯罪本来就是一条庞大的产业链，就没有一个地方，能做到纵容一种犯罪的同时控制好其他相关犯罪的。
en: And this black industrial chain has not been severed to this day... crime itself is a vast industrial chain, and there is no place that can tolerate one kind of crime while keeping other related crimes under control.

text: 而在那些从事性交易的女性中，绝大部分开始是不愿意从事“娼妓”的，但犯罪分子有的是办法让你“愿意”。
en: And among those women engaged in sex trading, the vast majority were unwilling at first to engage in "prostitution", but criminals have no shortage of ways to make you "willing".

text: 比如「毒品」就是一种常见的操纵手段，如今有相当多的妓女是“以娼养吸”，使得毒品犯罪猖獗的同时艾滋病泛滥......
en: For instance, "drugs" are a common means of manipulation; nowadays a considerable number of prostitutes "support their habit through prostitution", causing drug crime to flourish while AIDS spreads unchecked...

text: 在老电影《姊姊妹妹站起来》中，就讲述了新中国成立前，妓院对妇女的迫害，包括欺骗、PUA、殴打、虐待等等，比缅北好不到哪去，而“性”本就属于缅北犯罪集团的一大产业。
en: In the old film Sisters Stand Up, it tells of the persecution of women by brothels before the founding of New China, including deception, PUA, beating, abuse and the like — no better than northern Myanmar, and "sex" itself is a major industry of the northern Myanmar criminal groups.

text: “性”作为人类最原始的冲动之一，你眼里看到的是“需求”，那必然有人会看到“市场”，而且由于其利润实在过于可观，伴随着“性”而诞生的犯罪就成了人类社会最难以根除的顽疾。
en: As one of humanity's most primitive impulses, "sex" — what you see is "demand", but someone will inevitably see "market", and because its profits are simply too substantial, the crimes born alongside "sex" become the most deep-rooted chronic affliction of human society.

text: 其中，“娼”毫无疑问的是对女性的一种剥削。
en: Among these, "prostitution" is unquestionably a form of exploitation of women.

text: 在大部分国家，“娼”都是被认为是“有伤风化的”，有损社会道德和公共秩序，并可能导致「人权侵犯」。
en: In most countries, "prostitution" is regarded as "harmful to public morals", damaging social morality and public order, and may lead to human rights violations.

text: “妓女”一词在任何地方都带有强烈的侮辱性意味——我想，任何一个正常人都不会希望看到自己的母亲、女儿、姐妹沦落为娼妓。
en: The word "prostitute" carries a strongly insulting connotation everywhere — I think no normal person would wish to see their own mother, daughter or sister fall into prostitution.

text: 而“娼”在多数国家无法禁绝甚至愈加泛滥，原因没别的，就是“禁不了”，因为它是根植于人性的，但禁不了，不意味着就要摆烂。
en: And "prostitution" cannot be eradicated in most countries, and even grows more rampant; the reason is nothing else but that "it cannot be banned", because it is rooted in human nature — but that it cannot be banned does not mean one should just give up.

text: 这世界上的所有事情都跟性有关系,除了性本身。
en: Everything in this world is related to sex, except sex itself.

text: 性关乎权力。
en: Sex is about power.

text: 有些国家的心态就是，既然禁不了，干脆就从睁一眼闭一眼，到渐渐不禁了，甚至还有人正在逐步推动合法化，将娼妓列为一种职业，让妓女办证，这样既解决了就业，又可以光明正大地收税——毕竟“收税”是一件极其重要的事。
en: The mentality of some countries is: since it cannot be banned, they simply go from turning a blind eye, to gradually not banning, and some are even progressively pushing for legalisation, listing prostitution as an occupation and having prostitutes obtain licences — this both solves employment and allows them to collect taxes openly and legitimately, after all, "tax collection" is an extremely important matter.

text: 而且，对于很多国家来说，相对于毒品、黑暴、难民等问题，“卖淫”真的算是一个比较小的问题了，真没那么高优先级，警力根本就不允许......
en: Moreover, for many countries, compared with issues such as drugs, rioting and refugees, "prostitution" really is a relatively minor problem, and genuinely not that high a priority; the police force simply does not allow it...
